hooks.command: GD="$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)"; [ -z "$GD" ] && exit 0; CHANGES="$(git diff -- '*.go'; git diff --cached -- '*.go'; git status --porcelain -- '*.go')"; [ -z "$CHANGES" ] && exit 0; HASH="$(printf '%s' "$CHANGES" | (sha256sum 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256) | awk '{print $1}')"; STATE="$GD/claude-go-style-review.hash"; PREV="$(cat "$STATE" 2>/dev/null)"; [ "$HASH" = "$PREV" ] && exit 0; printf '%s' "$HASH" > "$STATE"; jq -n --arg reason "Go files changed (or changed further) since the last check — run the go-style-review skill (invoke /go-style-review) against docs/go-style-guide.md before finishing." '{decision:"block", reason:$reason}'
